cost_basis: Elapsed wall time from owned Pod creation to deletion at $0.74/hour; estimate excludes storage.
storage_recovery: Shared model-volume quota interrupted p08 preparation before any p08 generation. The owned worktree moved to container disk after all 10,988 inventory entries and hashes matched. Shared models remained in place.

motion_diagnostic.meaning: Planned geometric displacement, not rendered optical flow or taste.

review_limits: Source paintings, camera-only previews, overview sheets and selected dense delivered-frame windows were inspected by the director and an independent agent. This does not establish continuous subjective playback quality. Human feedback is pending.
accepted_visual_limitations: Incidental human silhouettes appear near the waterfall.
Fine ink patterns and paper details redraw; normal playback must establish whether their shimmer is acceptable.

reviewer_check.ui_changes: Named route and film data only; existing player layout and controls unchanged. Browser interactions were not re-tested.
